question: What is the Future of Health project partnership between Henry Ford Health System, MSU, and the Pistons?
transcript_excerpt: The Future of Health project is a $3.3 billion investment that encompasses a new state-of-the-art 20-story hospital being built for technologies that don't exist yet, partnering with Michigan Central on development. It also includes a seven-story research building with MSU right next to Henry Ford's current corporate offices. These investments are intended to benefit people in Detroit through job creation and better healthcare access, while also attracting top medical talent to the city.

question: What is the Nick Gilbert Neurofibromatosis Research Institute at Henry Ford Health System?
transcript_excerpt: The Nick Gilbert Neurofibromatosis Research Institute will be housed in Henry Ford's new research center opening in 2027. It is the first brick-and-mortar facility in the world dedicated to researching neurofibromatosis, a rare condition that causes tumors to grow on the nerves throughout the body. Nick Gilbert is Dan Gilbert's son who had this condition, and while the center will focus on other conditions as well, this institute represents a major commitment to research infrastructure.
